takeaway: The anterior compartment holds tibialis anterior, EHL, EDL and peroneus tertius (deep peroneal nerve, anterior tibial artery); peroneus brevis is in the lateral compartment.

question.text: Which of the following muscles is not present in the anterior compartment of the leg?

lines.text: Picture the anterior compartment of the leg as a band on stage.
Tibialis anterior and extensor hallucis longus are playing up front,
with extensor digitorum longus and peroneus tertius, the drummer with the three.
The conductor is the deep peroneal nerve, which supplies them all; the anterior tibial artery feeds them.
Next door is the lateral compartment.
lines.say: (clears throat) Next door is the lateral compartment.

lines.text: Peroneus longus lives there, together with peroneus brevis.
So the muscle not found in the anterior compartment is peroneus brevis.
